description_full: Aris Mining Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and operation of gold properties in Canada, Colombia, and Guyana. It also explores for silver and copper deposits. Aris Mining Corporation was formerly known as GCM Mining Corp. and changed its name to Aris Mining Corporation in September 2022. The company was founded in 2022 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
ceo_bio: Mr. Neil  Woodyer FCA | Founder, CEO & Chair | Age 82 | Compensation: $2.2M (FY2025)

Each employee generates $36K of free cash flow annually. CEO compensation is 9× revenue per employee (modest relative to workforce productivity). Governance score flags elevated compensation governance risk (8/10).
financial_summary: Aris Mining Corporation is a mid-cap basic materials business with a $3.1B market cap on $928M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +44% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +7.2pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at 7% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.

The business throws off $129M in free cash flow — roughly 14 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 4.70× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 0.2× net debt/EBITDA, and interest coverage runs at 8.8×.

Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and within its sector the business captures 3.0× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.

Trade policy and tariff whiplash — materials producers are first-order casualties of protectionist swings, and margin gets squeezed from both input and output pricing.
